<!doctype html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head><base target="_top">
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>استعلام نتيجة الطالب</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --navy: #1d4a58;
      --navy-soft: #2f7f96;
      --green: #2f7f96;
      --green-bg: #eef7f8;
      --red: #b42318;
      --red-bg: #fff1f0;
      --amber: #9a6700;
      --amber-bg: #fff8e1;
      --ink: #172033;
      --muted: #667085;
      --line: #e8e2d7;
      --surface: #ffffff;
      --page: #fbfaf7;
      --shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(43, 55, 59, 0.10);
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      min-height: 100vh;
      color: var(--ink);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 12% 8%, rgba(21, 128, 61, 0.08), transparent 32%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #eef3f9 0, var(--page) 320px);
      font-family: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Cairo", Tahoma, sans-serif;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .page {
      width: min(1160px, calc(100% - 36px));
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 28px 0 56px;
    }

    .hero {
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      padding: 30px 30px 30px 215px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      color: #fff;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy), var(--navy-soft));
      border-top: 3px solid var(--gold, #c7ad70);
    }

    .hero-logo {
      position: absolute; z-index: 2; left: 28px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 150px; height: 122px; padding: 9px; border-radius: 18px;
      background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(13, 48, 59, .18);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-logo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; display: block; }

    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: auto -58px -76px auto;
      width: 220px;
      height: 220px;
      border: 32px solid rgba(199, 173, 112, 0.16);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .org-name {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      margin: 0 0 6px;
      font-size: clamp(25px, 4vw, 36px);
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .hero p {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
    }

    .panel {
      padding: 28px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      margin-top: 18px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.97);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .lookup-form {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      max-width: 820px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 24px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fbfaf7;
    }

    .field label {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .field input {
      width: 100%;
      height: 50px;
      padding: 0 16px;
      border: 1px solid #cfd5df;
      border-radius: 12px;
      color: var(--ink);
      background: #fff;
      font: inherit;
      font-size: 18px;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
    }

    .field input:focus {
      border-color: var(--navy-soft);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(23, 55, 94, 0.12);
    }

    .hint {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 6px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .submit {
      min-width: 150px;
      height: 50px;
      padding: 0 22px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 12px;
      color: #fff;
      background: var(--green);
      font: inherit;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform .15s, opacity .2s, box-shadow .2s;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(47, 127, 150, 0.22);
    }

    .submit:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .submit:disabled { opacity: .65; cursor: wait; box-shadow: none; }

    .form-actions {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .form-actions .submit,
    .form-actions .action-control {
      width: min(220px, 100%);
      min-height: 50px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .spinner {
      display: none;
      width: 17px;
      height: 17px;
      margin-left: 8px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .42);
      border-top-color: #fff;
      border-radius: 50%;
      vertical-align: middle;
      animation: spin .8s linear infinite;
    }

    .submit.loading .spinner { display: inline-block; }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    .message {
      display: none;
      margin-top: 18px;
      padding: 13px 15px;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      border-radius: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .message.show { display: block; }
    .message.error { color: var(--red); background: var(--red-bg); border-color: #f4c7c3; }
    .message.info { color: var(--navy-soft); background: #eef5ff; border-color: #cbdcf5; }

    .results { display: none; margin-top: 28px; }
    .results.show { display: block; }

    .results-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      padding: 18px 20px;
      border: 1px solid #cfe4d6;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: var(--green-bg);
    }

    .student-name { margin: 0; color: #0f5d2e; font-size: 22px; }

    .count {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      padding: 5px 11px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      color: #fff;
      background: var(--green);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .cards { display: grid; gap: 16px; }

    .result-card {
      position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 22px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line); border-top: 5px solid var(--card-accent, var(--teal)); border-radius: 20px;
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, #ffffff 0%, #fbfaf7 100%); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(11, 31, 58, 0.09);
    }
    .result-card::after {content:'';position:absolute;left:-38px;bottom:-48px;width:132px;height:132px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--card-accent,var(--teal));opacity:.055;pointer-events:none}
    .result-card.tone-teal{--card-accent:#2f7f96}.result-card.tone-gold{--card-accent:#b2924d}.result-card.tone-green{--card-accent:#398b62}.result-card.tone-navy{--card-accent:#244f68}

    .card-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 15px;
      padding-bottom: 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }

    .card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; }

    .badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: 31px;
      padding: 4px 11px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .badge.pass { color: var(--green); background: var(--green-bg); }
    .badge.fail, .badge.absent { color: var(--red); background: var(--red-bg); }
    .badge.pending { color: var(--amber); background: var(--amber-bg); }

    .details {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .detail {
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 11px;
      background: #fbfaf7;
    }

    .detail dt { margin: 0 0 3px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
    .detail dd { margin: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-weight: 700; }

    .score {
      color: var(--navy);
      background: #eef7f8;
      border: 1px solid #cfe2e7;
    }

    .page-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: flex-start;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 20px;
    }

    .action-control {
      min-height: 44px;
      padding: 0 18px;
      border: 1px solid var(--navy-soft);
      border-radius: 11px;
      color: var(--navy-soft);
      background: #ffffff;
      font: inherit;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .action-control.primary {
      color: #ffffff;
      background: var(--navy-soft);
    }

    .card-head-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .card-print {
      min-height: 34px;
      padding: 5px 12px;
      border: 1px solid var(--navy-soft);
      border-radius: 9px;
      color: var(--navy-soft);
      background: #fff;
      font: inherit;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background .2s, color .2s, transform .15s;
    }

    .card-print:hover {
      color: #fff;
      background: var(--navy-soft);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .pending-notice {
      display: none;
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border: 1px solid #f0d48a;
      border-radius: 12px;
      color: var(--amber);
      background: var(--amber-bg);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .pending-notice.show { display: block; }

    .privacy {
      margin: 18px 0 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 13px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    @media (max-width: 760px) {
      .page { width: min(100% - 20px, 680px); padding-top: 16px; }
      .hero, .panel { padding: 22px 18px; }
      .hero-logo { position: relative; left: auto; top: auto; transform: none; width: 170px; height: 120px; margin: 0 auto 16px; }
      .lookup-form { padding: 18px; }
      .form-actions { flex-direction: column; }
      .lookup-form { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .submit { width: 100%; }
      .details { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .details { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .results-head, .card-head { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; }
      .result-card { padding: 16px; }
    }

    @media print {
      @page { size: A4; margin: 12mm; }

      body { color: #000; background: #fff; }
      .page { width: 100%; padding: 0; }
      .hero {
        padding: 0 0 16px;
        border-bottom: 2px solid #c7ad70;
        border-radius: 0;
        color: var(--navy);
        background: #fff;
        text-align: center;
      }
      .hero::after, .hero p, .lookup-form, .message,
      .page-actions, .privacy, .card-print { display: none !important; }
      .hero-logo { position:relative; left:auto; top:auto; transform:none; width:155px; height:105px; margin:0 auto 10px; box-shadow:none; }
      .org-name { color: #7c6a3a; }
      .panel { padding: 18px 0 0; border: 0; box-shadow: none; }
      .results { display: block !important; margin-top: 0; }
      .results-head { border-color: #a9c9b3; background: #fff; }
      .result-card { box-shadow: none; break-inside: avoid; page-break-inside: avoid; }
      body.printing-single .result-card { display: none !important; }
      body.printing-single .result-card.print-target { display: block !important; }
      body.printing-single .count { display: none !important; }
      .details { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
      .detail, .score { border: 1px solid #d9d9d9; background: #fff; }
    }
     
    body{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans Arabic",sans-serif!important;background:linear-gradient(rgba(246,244,238,.96),rgba(246,244,238,.98)),repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 0 42px,rgba(201,168,102,.11) 43px 45px)!important;color:#17313d!important}
    h1,h2,h3,.submit{font-family:"Noto Kufi Arabic","IBM Plex Sans Arabic",sans-serif!important;letter-spacing:-.025em}

    .result-card{border-radius:20px!important;box-shadow:0 10px 25px rgba(28,58,68,.07)!important}.results-head{border-radius:17px!important}.journey,.timeline{border-radius:18px!important}
    @media(max-width:600px){.page{padding:9px!important}.hero{padding:25px 15px!important}.hero h1{font-size:25px!important}.panel{padding:18px 13px!important}.form-actions{flex-direction:column!important}.form-actions>*{width:100%!important}}
  </style>

<body>
  <main class="page">
    <section aria-labelledby="page-title">
      <header class="hero">
        <div class="hero-logo"><img src="https://ishrafquran.com/app/img/logo.jpg" alt="شعار جمعية تذكرة"></div>
        <div class="org-name">الجمعية الخيرية لتحفيظ القرآن الكريم بعسير</div>
        <h1 id="page-title">استعلام نتيجة الطالب</h1>
        <p>أدخل رقم الهوية أو الإقامة المكوّن من 10 أرقام لعرض جميع سجلات الاختبارات.</p>
      </header>

      <div class="panel">
        <form id="lookup-form" class="lookup-form" novalidate>
          <div class="field">
            <label for="id-number">رقم الهوية أو الإقامة</label>
            <input id="id-number" name="idNumber" type="text" inputmode="numeric"
              autocomplete="off" maxlength="10" placeholder="10 أرقام فقط"
              aria-describedby="id-hint" required>
            <span id="id-hint" class="hint">تُستخدم الهوية للتحقق فقط ولا تظهر ضمن النتائج.</span>
          </div>

          <div class="form-actions">
            <button id="submit-button" class="submit" type="submit">
              <span class="spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              <span id="button-label">استعلام</span>
            </button>
            <a class="action-control" href="https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzpDJKLle8sT7AyxX_EhFNbRkYm2aE4Ztd3dToGb_qaZZwX4YtNMEBc5xBAR5M7aq4r/exec" target="_top">الرجوع للرئيسية</a>
          </div>
        </form>

        <div id="message" class="message" role="alert" aria-live="polite"></div>

        <section id="results" class="results" aria-live="polite">
          <div class="results-head">
            <h2 id="student-name" class="student-name"></h2>
            <span id="results-count" class="count"></span>
          </div>
          <div id="pending-notice" class="pending-notice" role="status">توجد نتيجة لم تُعتمد بعد؛ ستظهر الدرجة والتقدير بعد اعتمادها من الجهة المختصة.</div>
          <div id="cards" class="cards"></div>
        </section>

        <p class="privacy">لا تعرض الصفحة رقم الهوية أو رقم الجوال ضمن النتائج.</p>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <script>
    (function () {
      'use strict';

      const form = document.getElementById('lookup-form');
      const idInput = document.getElementById('id-number');
      const submitButton = document.getElementById('submit-button');
      const buttonLabel = document.getElementById('button-label');
      const message = document.getElementById('message');
      const results = document.getElementById('results');
      const studentName = document.getElementById('student-name');
      const resultsCount = document.getElementById('results-count');
      const cards = document.getElementById('cards');
      const pendingNotice = document.getElementById('pending-notice');

      function normalizeDigits(value) {
        return String(value || '')
          .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, function (digit) {
            return String('٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(digit));
          })
          .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, function (digit) {
            return String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(digit));
          });
      }

      function setLoading(loading) {
        submitButton.disabled = loading;
        submitButton.classList.toggle('loading', loading);
        buttonLabel.textContent = loading ? 'جارٍ الاستعلام...' : 'استعلام';
      }

      function showMessage(text, type) {
        message.textContent = text || '';
        message.className = 'message show ' + (type || 'info');
      }

      function clearMessage() {
        message.textContent = '';
        message.className = 'message';
      }

      function clearResults() {
        results.classList.remove('show');
        studentName.textContent = '';
        resultsCount.textContent = '';
        pendingNotice.classList.remove('show');
        cards.replaceChildren();
      }

      function displayValue(value) {
        const text = String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value).trim();
        return text || 'غير متوفر';
      }

      function badgeClass(item) {
        const outcome = String(item.outcome || item.result || '');
        const attendance = String(item.attendanceStatus || '');

        if (attendance === 'غائب' || attendance === 'غايب') return 'absent';
        if (outcome.indexOf('لم يجتز') !== -1) return 'fail';
        if (outcome === 'اجتاز') return 'pass';
        return 'pending';
      }

      function addDetail(list, label, value, extraClass) {
        const item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = 'detail' + (extraClass ? ' ' + extraClass : '');

        const term = document.createElement('dt');
        term.textContent = label;

        const description = document.createElement('dd');
        description.textContent = displayValue(value);

        item.append(term, description);
        list.appendChild(item);
      }

      function createResultCard(item, index) {
        const card = document.createElement('article');
        card.className = 'result-card ' + ['tone-teal', 'tone-gold', 'tone-green', 'tone-navy'][index % 4];

        const head = document.createElement('div');
        head.className = 'card-head';

        const title = document.createElement('h3');
        title.className = 'card-title';
        title.textContent = 'سجل الاختبار ' + (index + 1);

        const badge = document.createElement('span');
        badge.className = 'badge ' + badgeClass(item);
        badge.textContent = displayValue(item.outcome || item.result || item.status);

        const headActions = document.createElement('div');
        headActions.className = 'card-head-actions';

        const printAction = document.createElement('button');
        printAction.className = 'card-print';
        printAction.type = 'button';
        printAction.textContent = 'طباعة نتيجة هذا الاختبار';
        printAction.setAttribute('aria-label', 'طباعة نتيجة ' + title.textContent);
        printAction.addEventListener('click', function () {
          printSingleCard(card);
        });

        headActions.append(badge, printAction);
        head.append(title, headActions);

        const list = document.createElement('dl');
        list.className = 'details';

        addDetail(list, 'المرحلية', item.level);
        addDetail(list, 'حالة الاختبار', item.status || item.examStatus);
        addDetail(list, 'الحضور', item.attendanceStatus);
        addDetail(list, 'النتيجة', item.outcome || item.result);
        addDetail(list, 'تاريخ الاختبار', item.examDate);
        addDetail(list, 'الدرجة', item.finalDegree || item.degree, 'score');
        addDetail(list, 'التقدير', item.grade, 'score');
        addDetail(list, 'الموعد', item.appointment);
        addDetail(list, 'المركز', item.examVenue);
        addDetail(list, 'الحلقة', item.groupName);
        addDetail(list, 'حالة الرفع على النظام', item.uploadedStatus || item.uploadedToSystem);
        addDetail(list, 'حالة الشهادة', item.certificateDeliveryStatus, item.certificateDelivered ? 'score' : '');
        if (item.rewardEligible) addDetail(list, 'حالة المكافأة', item.rewardDeliveryStatus, item.rewardReceived ? 'score' : '');

        card.append(head, list);
        return card;
      }

      function printSingleCard(card) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.result-card.print-target').forEach(function (item) {
          item.classList.remove('print-target');
        });
        card.classList.add('print-target');
        document.body.classList.add('printing-single');

        function cleanupPrint() {
          document.body.classList.remove('printing-single');
          card.classList.remove('print-target');
        }

        window.addEventListener('afterprint', cleanupPrint, { once: true });
        window.print();
      }

      function renderResponse(response) {
        setLoading(false);
        clearResults();

        if (!response || !response.ok) {
          showMessage(
            response && response.message
              ? response.message
              : 'تعذر إكمال الاستعلام حاليًا. حاول مرة أخرى.',
            'error'
          );
          return;
        }

        const items = Array.isArray(response.results) ? response.results : [];
        if (!items.length) {
          showMessage('لم يتم العثور على بيانات مطابقة. تأكد من رقم الهوية.', 'error');
          return;
        }

        clearMessage();
        studentName.textContent = displayValue(items[0].studentName);
        resultsCount.textContent = items.length === 1
          ? 'سجل واحد'
          : items.length + ' سجلات';

        items.forEach(function (item, index) {
          cards.appendChild(createResultCard(item || {}, index));
        });

        const hasPendingResult = items.some(function (item) {
          const state = [item.outcome, item.result, item.status]
            .map(function (value) { return String(value || ''); })
            .join(' ');
          return state.indexOf('بانتظار اعتماد') !== -1;
        });

        pendingNotice.classList.toggle('show', hasPendingResult);
        results.classList.add('show');
        results.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
      }

      function handleFailure() {
        setLoading(false);
        clearResults();
        showMessage('تعذر الاتصال بخدمة النتائج. حاول مرة أخرى لاحقًا.', 'error');
      }

      idInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
        const normalized = normalizeDigits(idInput.value)
          .replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')
          .slice(0, 10);
        idInput.value = normalized;
      });

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        if (submitButton.disabled) return;

        clearMessage();
        clearResults();

        const idNumber = normalizeDigits(idInput.value).trim();
        if (!/^[0-9]{10}$/.test(idNumber)) {
          showMessage('رقم الهوية أو الإقامة يجب أن يتكون من 10 أرقام فقط.', 'error');
          idInput.focus();
          return;
        }

        setLoading(true);

        const payload = {
          action: 'studentresult',
          idNumber: idNumber,
          source: 'Manus - استعلام نتيجة الطالب'
        };

        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(renderResponse)
          .withFailureHandler(handleFailure)
          .studentResultRequest(payload);
      });
    }());
  </script>
<script data-system-arabic-digits="enabled">(function(){var digits="٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩";function arabicNumberText(value){return String(value==null?"":value).replace(/[0-9]/g,function(d){return digits.charAt(Number(d));});}function excluded(node){var parent=node&&node.parentElement;return !parent||/^(SCRIPT|STYLE|NOSCRIPT|CODE|PRE)$/i.test(parent.tagName);}function convertText(node){if(!node||excluded(node))return;var next=arabicNumberText(node.nodeValue);if(next!==node.nodeValue)node.nodeValue=next;}function convertAttributes(root){if(!root||root.nodeType!==1)return;var elements=[root].concat(Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll("[title],[aria-label],[placeholder]")));elements.forEach(function(el){["title","aria-label","placeholder"].forEach(function(name){if(!el.hasAttribute(name))return;var oldValue=el.getAttribute(name),newValue=arabicNumberText(oldValue);if(newValue!==oldValue)el.setAttribute(name,newValue);});});}function convertTree(root){if(!root)return;if(root.nodeType===3){convertText(root);return;}if(root.nodeType!==1&&root.nodeType!==9&&root.nodeType!==11)return;convertAttributes(root.nodeType===1?root:null);var walker=document.createTreeWalker(root,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);var node;while((node=walker.nextNode()))convertText(node);}function start(){convertTree(document.body);new MutationObserver(function(records){records.forEach(function(record){if(record.type==="characterData")convertText(record.target);Array.prototype.forEach.call(record.addedNodes||[],convertTree);});}).observe(document.body,{subtree:true,childList:true,characterData:true});}if(document.readyState==="loading")document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",start,{once:true});else start();})();</script></body>
